original_test_intent: Install an approved Intel SSMD build and CPU access driver, run the named max-TDP stress flow with explicitly authorized oc_enable=1 for one hour, and verify sustained CPU load completes without hang, unexpected errors or loss of system manageability.
original_method: Verify signed SSMD archive, license and CPU/OS/kernel/compiler matrix; snapshot modules/boot config/telemetry/logs; build cpuaccess against exact headers with recorded output; inspect module metadata/signature before one-time load; verify device permissions; avoid persistent bootupdate unless separately approved; validate the exact flow JSON; run under hard wall-time, thermal/power/RAS/watchdog and OOB supervision; capture SSMD/ssmon/exit/log evidence; unload/restore the driver and boot state.
manual_activity: Engineer authorizes licensed tool, privileged driver and OC/max-power envelope; lab operator maintains cooling, power and OOB recovery.
required_inputs: Exact flowStressTdp JSON and Program value
safety_requirements: Inspect module provenance before root load
Do not persist driver at boot by default
Apply hard timeout and independent telemetry
Abort on threshold, RAS, throttle, hang or watchdog failure
No automatic retry or log clearing
engineer_actions: Approve license, module and OC envelope

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its package/driver gate is correct but not sufficient for the literal SSMD flow and OC-enabled one-hour run.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the approved archive and exact flow JSON; load cpuaccess once, then supervise `sudo ./ssmd -f flowStressTdp<Program>.json -u oc_enable=1` for the approved hour with optional ssmon as evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: cpuaccess build/load, device node, flowStressTdp, oc_enable=1, one hour and ssmon profiles retained; bootupdate is separately gated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run in a maintenance window with immutable inputs, independent BMC/OS telemetry, hard aborts and reversible module/boot changes.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds artifact trust, kernel compatibility, nonpersistent default, numeric health stops and OOB recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic vendor diagnostic report cannot substitute for the specified max-TDP OC-enabled flow duration.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Out-of-tree kernel code and OC-enabled sustained power can hang the host or exceed cooling/power margins; application logs alone may miss hardware telemetry faults.

project_override_considerations: Owner supplies supported CPU/platform list, exact Program token/flow content, expected utilization/power, allowed throttling, telemetry cadence and whether bootupdate is ever in scope.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek is incomplete but correctly aligned with the licensed SSMD package, driver and long-run method.

review_improvement: Separates software installation, privileged kernel mutation and sustained OC/max-power execution into independently authorized phases.
independent_technical_reasoning: A successful device node only proves the module loaded, not that it is safe or compatible. The one-hour criterion also needs independent power, temperature and RAS monitoring because a workload can remain responsive while silently throttling or accumulating hardware errors.
